```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: 🧪 Run E2E tests with Playwright
        run: |
          yarn workspace @instantsearch/e2e-tests test:playwright
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3456
          E2E_BROWSER: chromium

      - name: 🧪 Run Next.js E2E tests
        run: |
          yarn workspace react-instantsearch-nextjs test:playwright
          yarn workspace react-instantsearch-router-nextjs test:playwright
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3456

      - name: 🧪 Run IE11 tests via Sauce Labs
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          yarn test:e2e:ie11
        env:
          SAUCE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_USERNAME }}
          SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY }}

      - name: 📊 Upload test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: '**/test-results.xml'
          check_name: Test Results

      - name: 📝 Generate documentation
        run: |
          yarn doctoc
```

name: Docs Automation

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: 🧪 Run E2E tests with Playwright

          yarn workspace @instantsearch/e2e-tests test:playwright

          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3456

      - name: 🧪 Run Next.js E2E tests

          yarn workspace react-instantsearch-nextjs test:playwright
